what: ENT-11(3) evidence capture: the PRODUCTION shape of BrokerGateway.positions() -- the primitive the per-leg resolver's authority rests on. v2.01 made this capture BLOCKING on the resolver build.
environment: PRODUCTION, read-only. Session + Account.get + Account.get_positions (a GET). No order was built, submitted, replaced, cancelled or dry-run.
curation_note: 9 of the operator's unrelated single-name option/equity positions are omitted from `observation` below; they carry no symbology or shape information the retained rows do not. NOTHING about the payload's shape, field set, or types is redacted -- `field_shape` and `findings` are derived from all 13 rows. The retained rows are the ones that carry evidence: both SPXW rows (the FOREIGN-collision vector), one non-SPX equity option (root-padding width variation), one Equity and one Cryptocurrency (non-option instrument types sharing the same list).

field_shape.note: Values below are rendered as strings by the capture; the SDK types them Decimal (quantity, prices, multiplier, restricted_quantity), InstrumentType enum (instrument_type), datetime (created_at, updated_at, expires_at). `quantity` is a Decimal, never an int.

SYMBOL_BYTE_IDENTITY_CONFIRMED.claim: A broker position symbol matches a journaled CondorFilled.legs symbol byte-for-byte for the equity-option (SPXW) path.

evidence.root_field: left-justified, space-padded to 6 -- 'SPXW  ' in BOTH; 'SPY   ' (3+3) and 'BE    ' (2+4) prove the padding is to width 6, not a fixed suffix
evidence.layout: root(6) + YYMMDD(6) + C|P(1) + strike*1000 zero-padded(8) = OCC-21

SYMBOL_BYTE_IDENTITY_CONFIRMED.consequence: The v2.01 failure direction -- resolver returns TERMINAL_NO_POSITION for a leg we HOLD, ORD-12 refuses the close, and it presents as a take-profit that never fires -- is RULED OUT for SPX/SPXW. It remains OPEN for /ES (see UNOBSERVED below).

QUANTITY_IS_UNSIGNED.claim: `quantity` carries NO direction. Long and short both return a positive Decimal; direction lives in the separate `quantity_direction` field ('Long' | 'Short').
QUANTITY_IS_UNSIGNED.consequence: A resolver that reads `quantity` alone cannot tell a short leg from a long one. Sign must come from `quantity_direction`, never from the number.

FOREIGN_SPX_LEGS_ARE_PRESENT_TODAY.claim: The production account ALREADY holds SPXW positions that are not the bot's -- a far-dated operator call spread.
FOREIGN_SPX_LEGS_ARE_PRESENT_TODAY.consequence: The resolver must discriminate on the FULL OCC symbol (which encodes the expiration). Any match on `underlying_symbol` alone, or on root+right, would collide with the operator's own book. This is OWN-01/OWN-03's quarantine case, present in live data.

MIXED_INSTRUMENT_TYPES_SHARE_THE_LIST.claim: positions() returns Equity and Cryptocurrency rows alongside Equity Option rows, in one unfiltered list.
MIXED_INSTRUMENT_TYPES_SHARE_THE_LIST.consequence: Any iteration over positions() must tolerate rows whose `symbol` is not an OCC-21 string and whose `expires_at` is null. Parsing every row as an option would raise on the operator's stock and crypto.

RESTRICTED_QUANTITY_EXISTS.consequence: Observed zero everywhere today, so its non-zero behaviour is UNOBSERVED. The resolver must not silently assume quantity == closeable quantity.

unobserved_residual.FUTURES_OPTION_SYMBOLOGY: No /ES position is held, so the futures-option symbol format AS RETURNED BY positions() is still unobserved. The only recorded futures-option symbol is from a 2026-07-21 PROD instrument probe ('./ESU6 E3BN6 260721C7185'), which is the FutureOption instrument's symbol, NOT a positions() row. Per ENT-11(2)/NFR-09 the resolver must therefore return UNKNOWN -- never TERMINAL_NO_POSITION -- for any instrument type it has not observed.
